prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: The parent's criticality-aware area repair shrinks critical macros' *effective* area by a fixed 3.0 coefficient, but c026/c027 showed the exact coefficient is fragile (6.0 helped some cases, 3.0 others); make the shrink coefficient scale gently with the graph's own criticality spread so it stays modest on flat-criticality designs (where no macro is truly special) and only grows where criticality is concentrated — a robustness fine-tune (x0.5 floor / x2 ceiling around the proven 3.0) rather than a new mechanism.
Rule-based digest:
total=-inf robust(mean-std)=-inf min_case=-inf all_valid=False
  failures: bp_fe-ng45/1001:KeyError in partition; bp_fe-ng45/1002:HBT min-spacing violation; bp_fe-ng45/1003:KeyError in partition; bp-ng45/1001:HBT min-spacing violation; bp-ng45/1002:legalization overlap; bp-ng45/1003:legalization overlap
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: Invalid: mixed legality failures (HBT min-spacing, legalization overlap) and crashes (KeyError in partition), systematic across all seeds/cases — so nothing is learned about the hypothesis. The KeyError suggests the criticality-spread scaling reads a missing/empty graph attribute; the spacing/overlap failures suggest the scaled coefficient perturbs macro sizing before legalization without re-checking spacing. To make the idea legal: guard the spread computation with a default when the attribute is absent, clamp the coefficient before sizing, and add a post-resize spacing/legality check (or defer shrink until after legalization). Then re-run.
